-- public.vw_creditos_activos source
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_creditos_activos AS WITH cte_disburment AS ( SELECT d.id, d.loan_id, d.expected_disburse_date, d.disbursedon_date, d.principal, d.net_disbursal_amount, d.is_reversed, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.loan_id ORDER BY d.disbursedon_date) AS rn FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail d ), cte_data AS ( SELECT id_type_cv.code_value AS tipo_identificacion, ccp."Cedula" AS numero_identificacion, (mc.firstname::text || ' '::text) || mc.lastname::text AS nombre_titular_cuenta, ia.codigo_promotor, ml.account_no AS identificador_cuenta, mpl.name AS nombre_prestamo, ml.principal_amount AS monto_prestamo, ia2.value_buy AS valor_compra, ml.principal_disbursed_derived AS monto_desembolsado, ml.number_of_repayments AS numero_coutas, ml.nominal_interest_rate_per_period AS tasa, ia.verificacion_riesgo, to_char( CASE WHEN NULLIF(ml.approvedon_date::text, ''::text) IS NULL THEN NULL::date WHEN NULLIF(ml.approvedon_date::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(ml.approvedon_date::text, ''::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) WHEN NULLIF(ml.approvedon_date::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(ml.approvedon_date::text, ''::text), 'DD/MM/YYYY'::text) ELSE NULL::date END::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) AS fecha_aprobacion, to_char( CASE WHEN NULLIF(ml.disbursedon_date::text, ''::text) IS NULL THEN NULL::date WHEN NULLIF(ml.disbursedon_date::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(ml.disbursedon_date::text, ''::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) WHEN NULLIF(ml.disbursedon_date::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(ml.disbursedon_date::text, ''::text), 'DD/MM/YYYY'::text) ELSE NULL::date END::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) AS fecha_desembolso, to_char( CASE WHEN NULLIF(ml.expected_firstrepaymenton_date::text, ''::text) IS NULL THEN NULL::date WHEN NULLIF(ml.expected_firstrepaymenton_date::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(ml.expected_firstrepaymenton_date::text, ''::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) WHEN NULLIF(ml.expected_firstrepaymenton_date::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(ml.expected_firstrepaymenton_date::text, ''::text), 'DD/MM/YYYY'::text) ELSE NULL::date END::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) AS primer_pago, mlaa.principal_overdue_derived AS capital_pendiente, mlaa.interest_overdue_derived AS interes_pendiente, mlaa.fee_charges_overdue_derived AS cargos_pendientes, 0 AS impuestos_pendientes, mlaa.penalty_charges_overdue_derived AS penalidad_pendiente, mlaa.total_overdue_derived AS total_pendiente, ml.principal_repaid_derived AS capital_pagado, ml.interest_repaid_derived AS interes_pagado, ml.fee_charges_repaid_derived AS cargos_pagados, 0 AS impuestos_pagados, ml.penalty_charges_repaid_derived AS penalidad_pagada, ml.principal_repaid_derived + ml.interest_repaid_derived + ml.fee_charges_repaid_derived + 0::numeric + ml.penalty_charges_repaid_derived AS total_pagado, ml.principal_disbursed_derived - ml.principal_repaid_derived AS saldo_capital, ml.interest_charged_derived - ml.interest_repaid_derived AS saldo_interes, ml.fee_charges_charged_derived - ml.fee_charges_repaid_derived AS saldo_cargos, ml.penalty_charges_charged_derived - ml.penalty_charges_repaid_derived AS saldo_penalidad, ml.principal_disbursed_derived - ml.principal_repaid_derived + (ml.interest_charged_derived - ml.interest_repaid_derived) + (ml.fee_charges_charged_derived - ml.fee_charges_repaid_derived) + (ml.penalty_charges_charged_derived - ml.penalty_charges_repaid_derived) AS saldo_total, mc.mobile_no AS celular, ccp."Direccion" AS direccion, mc.email_address AS email, state_l.enum_value AS estado_credito, CASE WHEN mlaa.total_overdue_derived >= 30000::numeric AND (CURRENT_DATE - CASE WHEN NULLIF(mlaa.overdue_since_date_derived::text, ''::text) IS NULL THEN NULL::date WHEN NULLIF(mlaa.overdue_since_date_derived::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(mlaa.overdue_since_date_derived::text, ''::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) WHEN NULLIF(mlaa.overdue_since_date_derived::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(mlaa.overdue_since_date_derived::text, ''::text), 'DD/MM/YYYY'::text) ELSE NULL::date END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_arrears, CASE WHEN mlaa.total_overdue_derived >= 30000::numeric AND (CURRENT_DATE - CASE WHEN NULLIF(mlaa.overdue_since_date_derived::text, ''::text) IS NULL THEN NULL::date WHEN NULLIF(mlaa.overdue_since_date_derived::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(mlaa.overdue_since_date_derived::text, ''::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) WHEN NULLIF(mlaa.overdue_since_date_derived::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(mlaa.overdue_since_date_derived::text, ''::text), 'DD/MM/YYYY'::text) ELSE NULL::date END) > 0 THEN CURRENT_DATE - CASE WHEN NULLIF(mlaa.overdue_since_date_derived::text, ''::text) IS NULL THEN NULL::date WHEN NULLIF(mlaa.overdue_since_date_derived::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(mlaa.overdue_since_date_derived::text, ''::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) WHEN NULLIF(mlaa.overdue_since_date_derived::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(mlaa.overdue_since_date_derived::text, ''::text), 'DD/MM/YYYY'::text) ELSE NULL::date END ELSE 0 END AS dias_mora, to_char( CASE WHEN NULLIF(ml.closedon_date::text, ''::text) IS NULL THEN NULL::date WHEN NULLIF(ml.closedon_date::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(ml.closedon_date::text, ''::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) WHEN NULLIF(ml.closedon_date::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(ml.closedon_date::text, ''::text), 'DD/MM/YYYY'::text) ELSE NULL::date END::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) AS fecha_cierre, NULL::text AS fecha_esperada_cierre, ib.entidad_financiera, 'pendiente'::text AS subestado_cuenta, ec.fecha_bloqueo, tipo_bloqueo.code_value AS tipo_bloqueo, to_char( CASE WHEN NULLIF(ml.submittedon_date::text, ''::text) IS NULL THEN NULL::date WHEN NULLIF(ml.submittedon_date::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(ml.submittedon_date::text, ''::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) WHEN NULLIF(ml.submittedon_date::text, ''::text) ~ '^\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4}$'::text THEN to_date(NULLIF(ml.submittedon_date::text, ''::text), 'DD/MM/YYYY'::text) ELSE NULL::date END::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) AS fecha_creacion, ec.reestructurado, tipo_garantia.code_value AS tipo_garantia, ia.codigo_promotor_original, estado_garantia.code_value AS estado_garantia, CASE WHEN vo."SiNoNoAplica_cd_retanqueo" = 2491 THEN 'Si'::text WHEN vo."SiNoNoAplica_cd_retanqueo" = 2492 THEN 'No'::text WHEN vo."SiNoNoAplica_cd_retanqueo" = 2493 THEN 'No Aplica'::text ELSE NULL::text END AS retanqueo, tipo_credito.code_value AS tipo_credito, tipo_producto.code_value AS tipo_producto FROM m_loan ml JOIN m_client mc ON ml.client_id = mc.id JOIN campos_cliente_persona ccp ON mc.id = ccp.client_id LEFT JOIN m_code_value id_type_cv ON id_type_cv.id = ccp."Customer Identifier_cd_Tipo identificacion" LEFT JOIN "Informacion Adicional" ia ON ml.id = ia.loan_id LEFT JOIN m_product_loan mpl ON ml.product_id = mpl.id LEFT JOIN "Alianzas" ia2 ON ml.id = ia2.loan_id LEFT JOIN m_loan_arrears_aging mlaa ON ml.id = mlaa.loan_id LEFT JOIN r_enum_value state_l ON ml.loan_status_id = state_l.enum_id AND state_l.enum_name::text = 'loan_status_id'::text LEFT JOIN "Informacion Bancaria" ib ON ml.id = ib.loan_id LEFT JOIN "Estado Cartera" ec ON ml.id = ec.loan_id LEFT JOIN m_code_value tipo_bloqueo ON ec."Tipo Bloqueo_cd_Tipo Bloqueo" = tipo_bloqueo.id LEFT JOIN "Detalle garantia" dg ON ml.id = dg.loan_id LEFT JOIN m_code_value estado_garantia ON dg."Estado Garantía_cd_Estado Garantía" = estado_garantia.id LEFT JOIN m_code_value tipo_garantia ON dg."Tipo Garantía_cd_Tipo Garantía" = tipo_garantia.id LEFT JOIN m_code_value tipo_producto ON dg."Tipo Producto_cd_Tipo Producto" = tipo_producto.id LEFT JOIN "Validacion Operacion" vo ON ml.id = vo.loan_id LEFT JOIN m_code_value tipo_credito ON vo."Tipo Credito_cd_Tipo Credito" = tipo_credito.id WHERE ml.loan_status_id = 300 ) SELECT tipo_identificacion, numero_identificacion, nombre_titular_cuenta, codigo_promotor, identificador_cuenta, nombre_prestamo, monto_prestamo, valor_compra, monto_desembolsado, numero_coutas, tasa, verificacion_riesgo, fecha_aprobacion, fecha_desembolso, primer_pago, capital_pendiente, interes_pendiente, cargos_pendientes, impuestos_pendientes, penalidad_pendiente, total_pendiente, capital_pagado, interes_pagado, cargos_pagados, impuestos_pagados, penalidad_pagada, total_pagado, saldo_capital, saldo_interes, saldo_cargos, saldo_penalidad, saldo_total, celular, direccion, email, estado_credito, in_arrears, dias_mora, fecha_cierre, fecha_esperada_cierre, entidad_financiera, subestado_cuenta, fecha_bloqueo, tipo_bloqueo, fecha_creacion, reestructurado, tipo_garantia, codigo_promotor_original, estado_garantia, retanqueo, tipo_credito, tipo_producto FROM cte_data;
